supported_conclusion: The report-level warning identifies a specific observation need. It does not reproduce current consent/event ordering or justify an exact production repair. Current disconnected legacy pixel, app Optimized/Access on and measurement On are configuration evidence only.

resolved_findings.defect: Guidance called grant/decline/withdrawal steps a permitted test owned by root under existing scope, contradicting this delegation prohibition on consent changes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final guidance assigns the original owner, marks choice transitions FUTURE_QA_REQUIRES_SEPARATELY_PERMITTED_SCOPE, prefixes steps 2/4 as not authorized here, and restricts current execution to passive read-only observation.

resolved_findings.raised_by: Root before final freeze; verified by independent reviewer
resolved_findings.defect: Initial live_state_mode used the next-action classification rather than STALE_READBACK_REQUIRED.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final diagnosis separates live state from next_best_action, retains the canonical source date 2026-06-01, sets autonomous_action_ready false, and keeps current Shopify timing scoped to configuration.

limitations: Current Shopify observations are transcribed by the operator without full saved DOM or screenshots. This reviewer did not independently inspect runtime settings, sender provenance or consent sequencing.

Historical Tag Assistant default/Consent-tab disagreement and later QA transport remain dated, incomplete evidence. QA choices, G111/gcd fields, HTTP success and purchase reporting do not establish the real purchaser named consent state or current startup order.

Optimized data access does not affect standalone analytics according to the stored Shopify guidance. Applicability to a specific mixed-use app event requires identifying that event/use case; Access on now is not historical access proof.
Exact current tag destinations were not expanded successfully. September 11 tag mappings and older enabled campaign state remain historical and do not refresh the current account.

The eleven official summaries and three blocked-source dispositions were reviewed locally. No documentation URLs were requested, retried or independently revalidated; document research is not independent causal verification.

The accepted purchase/report evidence is reused within its prior report-level, intraday, private-join and raw-event limitations. No new Ads read, private transaction match, purchaser consent determination, sender deduplication, profit or other-market acceptance follows.

Parent cohort totals, paused baseline, publication ownership and canonical fields were checked only for preservation and labeling in supplied sources. No shared canonical audit or live refresh occurred.
